question: Does treatment change the prespecified continuous outcome in the deterministic fixture?

outcome.name: response
outcome.measurement: one prespecified continuous value per sample

assignment.mechanism: balanced assignment fixed before outcome values

analysis.method: difference in means with exact randomization test and bootstrap interval

primary_endpoints.decision_threshold: report effect and interval; do not equate p-value with importance

missing_data.assumptions: the deterministic fixture contains no missing values

criteria: exclude only malformed or non-finite records before analysis

stopping.decision_rule: analyze once after all eight fixture samples are present
